quandoUsar: A create button, such as “New project”, that opens a short form coming out of the button itself.
Sharing or inviting from a toolbar button, with the list of people in the modal body.
Primary actions where the origin of the modal must be clear: the panel is born from the position, size, and color of the button.
quandoEvitar: Use `dialog` when the modal is opened by code, by a menu item, or by more than one trigger; here the trigger is always the component's own button.
Use `center-morph-modal` when the modals originate from cards in a grid.
Use `popover` for small content that does not need to block the page.

teclado.acao: On the button, opens the modal.
Move through the modal controls without leaving it; on open, focus goes to the first form field or, with no fields, to the close button.
Closes the modal, which turns back into the button, and returns focus to it.

acessibilidade: The button gets `aria-haspopup="dialog"` and `aria-expanded`; the panel is a Radix modal dialog with `title` as its name and `description` as its description.
To choose the initial focus, mark the element with `data-autofocus`; the close button is named “Close”, fixed in English in the code.
movimento: The panel grows from the button's box on a spring with a slight bounce and returns to it on an exact spring, without oscillating; it starts at the button color and lightens to the surface color.
Title, body, and footer arrive one after another, rising 10 px out of a slight blur, and leave all at once so they do not follow the shrinking.
With “reduce motion” on, there is no transformation: the panel only fades on open and close.
responsivo: The panel takes the screen width minus 2rem up to `width` (default 420 px), with a maximum height of `100dvh` minus 2rem and inner scrolling.
notasIA: `trigger` is the button's content (label and icon), not a button: the component draws its own `<button>`; style it with `variant` and `triggerClassName`.
`children` and `footer` accept a function that receives `{ close }`, useful for closing after saving.
Control it with `open` and `onOpenChange` when needed; import `MorphingModal` from `@/components/ryan-ui/morphing-modal/morphing-modal`.
